haiku.problem: The question treats Leviathan and "the dragon of the sea" as the same being and asks what the LORD does to Leviathan. Verse 27:1 names Leviathan as the one who receives judgment and says the dragon of the sea is slain, so "Slay it" is only supported if the two are identified. The question should name the dragon of the sea as the one slain, or ask about Leviathan's judgment instead.
